svg.title: Jet impact and impedance variables
svg.desc: A liquid jet of velocity Uj, density rho_l and sound speed c_l impacts a solid with impedance Zs. The contact pressure and steady dynamic pressure are different estimates.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jet speed becomes a boundary load through impact physics

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 射流速度通过冲击物理转化为边界载荷
